push.title: D 1-1 vs Toot DatÄss | You: 7.8 (best match performance of the season)
push.body:
A 7.8 against Toot DatÄss, BellyTb1. Good bones. Now let's hang some pictures on 'em.

THE GOOD
+ 26 passes. You stayed in the game every single minute.
+ A goal against Toot DatÄss, your 2nd straight match scoring. That's a finish they'll replay at the club banquet.
+ Won your matchup: 7.8 against their best midfielder's 6.7. I see you, and I like what I see.
+ 1-1 with Toot DatÄss. Respectable, with room to grow.

THE BAD
- No tackles attempted. Mark my words: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized. One rep at a time.
- No key passes from 26 passes. My two cents: Switch play when they shift across. Quickest way to find space is usually on the far side.
- Pass accuracy: 77%. Middle of the road; 87%+ is the fast lane.

Daily reps: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.

Before you go, BellyTb1: Heart wins the fifty-fifties.

Practice makes progress. - Coach Lasso

players.name: PhogsToffees

strengths.title: Getting shots off
strengths.coach: You kept finding ways to get shots off. Can't score 'em if you don't take 'em.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Made chances for your teammates. Unselfish football is the best kind.

weaknesses.detail: Shots on target: 33% (bottom quarter of forwards is 60% or less)
weaknesses.title: Shot selection
tips: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.
Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.
Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.
weaknesses.coach: A few too many shots went wide or over. Better looks, better results.

weaknesses.detail: 20/32 passes (62%) - below the ~72% point where extra passes start costing rating
weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

weaknesses.detail: Won 0 of 7 tackles (0%) - diving in; each miss leaves a runner free
weaknesses.title: Tackle timing
tips: Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.
Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.
Stay on your feet. Slide only when you're certain of the ball and there's somebody behind you.
weaknesses.coach: Diving in a bit too eager. Patience in the tackle.

push.title: D 1-1 vs Toot DatÄss | You: 7.2 (worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.2 against Toot DatÄss. A good honest shift, like a well-made chair.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at Toot DatÄss's goal. That's an attacking mindset.
+ 1 assist. You found gaps I didn't know were there, and I was looking.
+ You and BellyTb1 speak the same football language.
+ Passes attempted 32, from 22 in your previous match. Your teammates felt that, even if the scoreboard didn't.
+ Tackles attempted 7, from 0 in your previous match. I'd put that on a billboard if I could afford one.

THE BAD
- 1 of 3 shots on target. Try this: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.
- 62% passing (20 of 32). One more thing: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
- Won 0 of 7 tackles. Fundamentals: Show them down the line, toward the touchline and away from goal, then strike. Feet first, then flair.
- Key passes 0, from 5 in your previous match. That's the part of the tape we'll rewind.

Coach's drill: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.

Between you and me, PhogsToffees: Hope is a plan with its shoes untied. Tie 'em.

I believe in you. More importantly, I need you to believe in you. - Coach Lasso
